newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Dec skilled vacancies unchanged.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Dec skilled vacancies unchanged.

text.p: The Australian government's index of skilled job vacancies were unchanged in December, the Employment Department said on Thursday.
The index remained unchanged at 139 in December, following declines in each previous month of the year, the department said in a statement.
The index was 19.2 percent below the index for the same month in 1995.
Increases were recorded in nine of the 16 occupational groups, while four groups fell and three remained unchanged, it said.
The largest increases were 5.0 percent for the building trades sector, 4.0 percent for medical and science technicians, and 3.9 percent for electrical and electronics trades.
Food trades fell 4.2 percent and health diagnosis and treatment practitioners dropped 3.7 percent, the department said.
The index remained 110.6 percent above the recession low of 66 recorded in mid-1991.
The index measures skilled vacancy advertisements in the major city newspapers on the first Saturday of each month.
